active_goal.title: End-to-end Valheim network replacement and alpha workbench
active_goal.objective: Make each interaction produce observable evidence, preserve the workbench state, and reduce human testing to short intentional feel judgments.

milestones.title: Release foundation
milestones.focus: Freeze a known-good release and retain reproducible evidence.

milestones.title: Identity and admission
milestones.focus: Steam enrollment, compatibility, capacity, least privilege, and trusted proxy boundaries.

milestones.title: Companion client pull
milestones.focus: Hash-verified install, config preservation, rollback, diagnostics, and local workbench.

milestones.title: Traffic proof
milestones.focus: Append-only JSONL boundary evidence, retained dashboards, and run reconstruction.

milestones.title: Recipient correctness
milestones.focus: Recipient-scoped queues, readiness leases, reconnect/takeover, and synthetic N=2/N=10 proof.

milestones.title: External canary
milestones.focus: One trusted non-developer tester using the Companion-only route and a sealed personal trace.

milestones.title: Widening
milestones.focus: 2-4 then 5-8 player soak after correctness and synthetic qualifications.

milestones.title: Future authority
milestones.focus: Synthetic, replay, local-lab, and shadow experiments for relevance, ownership, replication, motion, and RPC claims.

execution_lanes.title: OMEN and i5 physical clients
execution_lanes.surface: Companion localhost plus the i5 SSH lane
execution_lanes.human_touch: join both clients once; then watch and annotate

execution_lanes.title: Docker headless/rendered lab clients
execution_lanes.limitation: Steam client volumes need one-time existing-character seeding

execution_lanes.title: GCP server and Gateway
execution_lanes.surface: public Gateway telemetry and existing operator tunnels
execution_lanes.guardrail: local workbench observes and drives allow-listed lab surfaces; it does not silently promote authority

reconstruct.principle: Reset the image, preserve the data volume, then reconstruct from source revision plus retained snapshots and captures.
never: docker compose down -v when evidence matters
treat a browser view as a receipt

steps.title: Record current workbench state
steps.result: Immutable redacted snapshot under the Companion data volume

steps.title: Reset to the latest source/image
steps.result: Rebuilds or starts the canonical Docker image while preserving companion-data

steps.title: Reconstruct the investigation
steps.command: Open /workbench, /trace, the latest snapshot, and the retained capture bundle
steps.result: Source pointer, milestone position, local status, and raw evidence are visible together

steps.title: Change one seam
steps.command: Run the smallest bounded synthetic or physical feel window
steps.result: New receipt references the source/image identity and leaves prior evidence untouched
